::: {style="width: 80%; margin: 0 auto; overflow: visible; font-size: 1.1rem;"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof t1_val = Inputs.range([0.1, 4.0], {value: 0.88, step: 0.05, label: "T₁ relaxation time (seconds)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof readout_time = Inputs.number([0, 6], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Readout time (seconds)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
t1_data = {
  const points = [];
  for (let t = 0; t <= 6; t += 0.02) {
    points.push({
      time: t,
      magnetization: 1 - Math.exp(-t / t1_val)
    });
  }
  return points;
}

readout_marker = [{
  time: readout_time,
  magnetization: 1 - Math.exp(-readout_time / t1_val)
}]

Plot.plot({
  grid: false,
  width: width,
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 170,
  marginRight: 32,
  marginBottom: 100,
  style: {
    color: "#1f1f1f",
    fontSize: "20px",
    fontWeight: 500,
    fontFamily: "system-ui, sans-serif"
  },
  y: {
    domain: [0, 1.1],
    axis: null
  },
  x: {
    domain: [0, 6],
    axis: null
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.gridX({strokeOpacity: 0.15}),
    Plot.gridY({strokeOpacity: 0.15}),
    Plot.axisY({
      label: "Normalized magnetization",
      labelAnchor: "center",
      labelArrow: "none",
      fill: "#1f1f1f",
      fontSize: 26,
      fontWeight: 500
    }),
    Plot.axisX({
      label: "Time after 90° excitation (s)",
      labelAnchor: "center",
      labelArrow: "none",
      fill: "#1f1f1f",
      fontSize: 26,
      fontWeight: 500
    }),
    Plot.line(t1_data, {x: "time", y: "magnetization", stroke: "#2e7d32", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.ruleX([readout_time], {stroke: "#d32f2f", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
    Plot.dot(readout_marker, {x: "time", y: "magnetization", fill: "#d32f2f", r: 6}),
    Plot.text(readout_marker, {
      x: "time",
      y: "magnetization",
      text: d => `At ${d.time.toFixed(1)} s: M_z / M_0 = ${d.magnetization.toFixed(3)}`,
      dy: readout_marker[0].magnetization > 0.85 ? 24 : -22,
      dx: readout_time > 3.7 ? -12 : 12,
      textAnchor: readout_time > 3.7 ? "end" : "start",
      fontSize: 20,
      fontWeight: "bold",
      fill: "#d32f2f"
    })
  ]
})
```
:::
